art_instructions: Inside the cozy Greek classroom, show a wide play area on a colorful geometric woven rug at the center, seen from a child’s eye level. The Owl (mottled brown-and-cream feathers, round amber eyes, small green scarf) is centered slightly left on the rug, kneeling with wings half-open and beak smiling as she gently rolls a soft pastel-red ball toward friends. Two anonymous animal classmates (one with long upright ears, one with a bushy tail) sit or kneel center-right and far right, arms outstretched to receive the ball, smiling with bright, playful expressions. Push the low honey-colored desks and chairs back along the top of the frame, grouped neatly to suggest they were moved for play; place the Owl’s tiny satchel on the floor beside the leftmost desk leg. Sunlight pours in from large windows on the right, casting soft, diffuse light; set a small green potted plant on the sill and a blue-and-white pottery piece on a simple podium at the back. Keep walls soft blue and clean—no letters or words—just simple shapes or blank boards so there is never any text. Maintain the cute chibi proportions and pastel palette, with clear silhouettes and minimal shading, and be sure no adults appear in the scene.
